messages:
incident-bot: [P1 ALERT] inference-p95 (hosted/us-east-1) jumped 180ms -> 740ms over last 5m. error-rate steady. customers: 3 active API keys showing increased latencies. paging oncall: @Jia Chen. dashboard: https://rbw.app/alerts/1937654321 :rotating_light:
Samir Patel: seeing same on internal perf dashboard. p50 barely moved, p95 exploded. curious if it's queuing or kernel-level stalls.
Samir Patel: quick ask — any recent infra deploys? anyone touching kernel/driver packages?
deploy-bot: host-pool rolling-update started 2024-11-22T12:00:00Z by infra/auto-roll (nodes: g4dn-*/us-east-1). batch size 20%.
Jia Chen: oncall here, ack. grabbing traces + `perf stat` from affected hosts. putting mitigation runbook on the thread.
Jia Chen: customer-impact check — Nisha, can you confirm which customers reported?
Nisha Kapoor: CS: 3 customers opened tickets in last 10m, 1 severe (checkout glitch). all on hosted API, region us-east. tickets: #2345 #2346 #2347.
Riley Gomez: I pulled a few Jaeger traces for sampled requests. attaching compact spans (id tails):
```
trace=ab12cd.. span=00a1 duration=612ms service=inference runtime=redwood-runtime-1
span=00a2 duration=58ms service=preproc
span=00a3 duration=520ms service=gpu-proxy wait=kernel_futex
```
Riley Gomez: the big chunk is a single span waiting on `futex`/sched. multiple traces show long syscalls.
Samir Patel: interesting — that points to kernel-level contention rather than model runtime compute. any `dmesg` or `uname` outputs from affected nodes?
Jia Chen: grabbing uname/dmesg now.
Jia Chen: `uname -a` on affected node: `Linux rbw-infer-13 6.2.0-rc1 #8 SMP Thu Nov 20 04:22:11 UTC 2024 x86_64 GNU/Linux`
Jia Chen: dmesg tail: `perf event overflow` and repeated `futex_wait_queue_me: blocked for 600ms` messages.
Riley Gomez: I ran a quick `perf top` and `perf stat` on a repro host — some counts:
```
# perf stat -e context-switches,cpu-migrations,page-faults,cycles -p <pid> sleep 10
      15,432 context-switches
       2,101 cpu-migrations
      12,890 page-faults
  8,912,345,678 cycles
```
Riley Gomez: context-switches high; matches scheduler thrash.
Nisha Kapoor: rollout timeline from infra: deploy-bot shows kernel image rolled to 6.2.0-rc1 starting 12:00 UTC, ~40% hosts finished by 12:18, 100% by 12:55.
Samir Patel: timeline note: metric spike started ~12:12 UTC which aligns with partial roll.
Jia Chen: HYPOTHESIS A: kernel 6.2.0-rc1 has a regression in futex/wake handling causing blocked threads -> p95 climb. HYPOTHESIS B: recent runtime patch changed thread pool sizing causing increased queueing interacting with kernel.
Riley Gomez: evidence for A: repeated futex messages + perf context-switch spike + identical spans waiting on futex. Evidence for B: no recent runtime deploys in last day (checked), so less likely.
Samir Patel: mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel on affected pool to previous stable (5.19.x) 2) route traffic away from affected hosts (fallback region) 3) temporary increase worker threads to reduce queue length (but might worsen if kernel stalls).
Jia Chen: I'm going to start traffic steering to non-rolled hosts and then open rollback on a small canary. executing: `redwoodctl routing set --model redwood-v2 --prefer region:us-west-2`
Jia Chen: executing NOW — reducing traffic to us-east by 60% for inference endpoints.
Samir Patel: thanks. also set autoscale to add extra dedicated workers in us-east as short term (command: `infractl scale pool inference-us-east +30%`).
deploy-bot: rollback job queued for pool rbw-infer-us-east (requested by Jia Chen). ETA for canary rollback start: 12:40 UTC.
Riley Gomez: after traffic shift p95 dropped from 740ms -> 220ms in 2 minutes for sampled keys. p50 unchanged ~40ms. Looks promising.
Nisha Kapoor: customer update prepared: "We observed elevated latencies in US-East; mitigation in progress; routing adjusted; full RCA to follow." Sending to CS. :white_check_mark:
Jia Chen: running additional checks to confirm root cause. collecting kernel oops logs and perf traces for infra team. tagging infra/kernel.
Samir Patel: recording timeline in-thread: 12:00 deploy start, 12:12 metric spike begins, 12:18 40% hosts with new kernel, 12:24 paging, 12:30 traffic steering started, 12:36 p95 improvement observed, 12:40 rollback canary started.
Riley Gomez: note: we still see a couple of affected hosts with new kernel but traffic away from them reduced; plan to complete rollback tonight unless kernel team has a hotfix.
Jia Chen: status: mitigation stable, customers notified, RCA hypothesis A prioritized. I'll open formal RCA doc and tag kernel/infra to investigate futex regression.
Samir Patel: great. assign follow-ups: infra to validate futex fixes / upstream kernel PR checks; runtime to evaluate threadpool interactions; ops to complete rollback and postmortem.
Nisha Kapoor: CS will keep customers updated hourly until fully resolved.
Samir Patel: thanks all. closing incident channel once rollback done and postmortem created. :thumbsup:
